body_html:
The Global Sora responds to your every movement, pairing a weight-sensing synchro-tilter with a breathable mesh back to keep you supported and focused through the full workday. Its streamlined silhouette suits private offices and open institutional floors alike, while three seat-width options and adjustable lumbar support let each user dial in a tailored ergonomic fit. Available in 24 mesh colours and a choice of two base finishes, it brings considered design to everyday task seating.

Features

  • Weight-sensing synchro-tilter mechanism that auto-balances recline tension to the user, no manual dialing required
  • Height-adjustable lumbar support for targeted lower-back comfort
  • Multifunctional adjustable arms
  • Three seat-width options — Petit (17"W), Standard (18.5"W) and Generous (19.5"W)
  • Breathable mesh back for all-day ventilation
  • 24 mesh colour options and a choice of two base finishes
  • Available in high-back (6941) and medium-back (6942) configurations

Specifications

The 6941 high back measures 25"W x 24"D x 42.5"H and the 6942 medium back measures 25"W x 24"D x 40.5"H. The Sora is fully compliant with the latest BIFMA G1, GSA and CGSB specifications and is made in Canada. It is backed by Global's Limited Lifetime Warranty on the frame and components, with 12 years on control mechanisms and 5 years on upholstery, foam and mesh.

Family-owned since 1964 and based at 296 George St N, Peterborough ON, Brant Business Interiors is an OECM-eligible supplier — Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote on the Sora, or call 1-800-835-9565.
